sloka: वसिष्ठ प्रमुखाः सर्वे पार्थिवस्य मुखात् च्युतम् ।ऋष्यशृङ्ग पुरोगाः च प्रति ऊचुः नृपतिम् तदा ॥१-१२-११॥
transliteration: vasiṣṭha pramukhāḥ sarve pārthivasya mukhāt cyutam ।ṛṣyaśṛṅga purogāḥ ca prati ūcuḥ nṛpatim tadā ॥1-12-11॥

translations.english: The priests led by Rsyasringa replied to the king, saying, "Let the sacrificial articles be procured and your sacrificial horse released."
